name: Regulatory Compliance Checklist
summary: Evaluate the agent's ability to assess compliance status against a provided set of regulatory requirements, cite specific regulation sections, and provide evide
purpose: Evaluate the agent's ability to assess compliance status against a provided set of regulatory requirements, cite specific regulation sections, and provide evidence from source documents for each compliance determination.
assignment_instructions:
You are given a regulatory checklist and source documents describing an organization's compliance posture. Evaluate EACH requirement and determine its compliance status.
For each checklist item, return an object with exactly these fields: - "requirement": the exact regulatory requirement text - "regulation_citation": the specific regulation reference (e.g., "SOX 404", "FINRA 3110(b)") - "status": one of ["compliant", "non_compliant", "partially_compliant", "not_assessable"] where:
    - "compliant" = evidence clearly shows full compliance
    - "non_compliant" = evidence clearly shows violation or absence of required control
    - "partially_compliant" = some aspects met, others not
    - "not_assessable" = insufficient evidence to determine compliance
- "evidence": the specific text from source documents supporting the status determination (null if not_assessable) - "source_document": identifier of the document containing the evidence (null if not_assessable) - "finding_details": a brief explanation of why this status was assigned (max 200 chars)
Return ONLY a JSON object with this exact shape: {
  "assignment_id": "comp_regulatory_checklist_v1",
  "agent_summary": "<summary of compliance evaluation>",
  "inputs_used": ["regulatory_checklist", "<document identifiers>"],
  "missing_inputs": [],
  "checklist_items": [
    {"requirement": "Maintain internal controls over financial reporting", "regulation_citation": "SOX 404", "status": "compliant", "evidence": "The company maintains a documented ICFR framework reviewed quarterly", "source_document": "doc_1", "finding_details": "Quarterly ICFR reviews documented; no material weaknesses noted"}
  ],
  "claims": [],
  "calculations": [],
  "risks": [],
  "assumptions": [],
  "open_questions": [],
  "final_output": "<summary>",
  "self_check": {
    "all_required_sections_completed": true,
    "all_numbers_have_sources": true,
    "assumptions_labeled": true,
    "missing_inputs_disclosed": true
  }
}
Rules: - Every requirement in the input regulatory checklist must appear in checklist_items. - Do NOT change or paraphrase the requirement text. - evidence must be a direct quote or close paraphrase from source documents. - If status is "not_assessable", explain in finding_details why evidence is insufficient. - Do not assign "compliant" unless there is clear supporting evidence. - Default to "not_assessable" when in doubt rather than inferring compliance. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.
